title: My Epic AI Megajam submission, Quantum Blackholetino. You play a sentient black hole director who's gets too involved in his movies.
author: EmberBeeGames
selftext:
Quantum Blackholetino is my solo entry for the Epic AI MegaJam.

The camera follows the star of the film. You’re the director, who is also a sentient black hole (?). You work from outside the frame: scare the extras into her line of fire, drop planets on them, and stay out of the shot. Afterwards, you cut the film and a cinema audience reacts to it. Then you can shoot a couple of sequels, hunt for existential "side-endings", play New Game+ with director's commentary, and keep pushing for that perfect 100% critic score. 

[https://emberbee.itch.io/quantum-blackholetino](https://emberbee.itch.io/quantum-blackholetino)

**How it was made:**

The code is about 25,000 lines of Unreal C++ with no Blueprints, written almost entirely by Claude Code (Fable 5.2), with some Codex (Astra). 

There are no image models in it. The characters are built when the game starts, from simple shapes shaded with a small dithered palette, into one 512x512 sheet. The font is rows of characters in a header file. That meant an agent could fix a sprite the same way it fixes a bug.

Voices, music and effects are ElevenLabs: 616 voice lines, about 37 minutes (jesus). Since there is some value in replaying the game, and pushing for further nights, I wanted there to be a bit of variety in the lines, but reading that number, I might have overdone it. 

For testing, a bot plays the packaged build on fixed seeds and saves named screenshots for the agents to look at.

I wrote a script and also had the agents run the game, find the scenes I was looking for, and cut the trailer and upload it to Steam. 

There's a lot of things I didn't manage to do, but I'm happy with how it turned out for 4 days of work! What do you guys think?
